subject: Vendor activation: invoice cutoff orchestration & fast settlement request
messages:
From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fastrail.co>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure_ops@fastrail.co
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor setup — invoice cutoff + inquiry about faster settlement options

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood integration yesterday. We're ready to move forward with vendor activation but need to align on a couple of operational items before we return our onboarding packet:

1) Invoice cutoff — our AP team does a weekly pull on Fridays. Can Redwood accept an invoice cutoff window that maps to our Friday batch (close of business PT) and still support next-PO acknowledgment?

2) Payment terms — our default is Net 45, but we're exploring faster-settlement options for select vendors (we typically call this "fast settlement" internally). Can you share what Redwood's options are for accelerated payment (e.g., settlement within 7–15 days) and any fees or enrollment steps?

I've attached the vendor onboarding form and a sample invoice so your team can see our fields.

Attachments: FastRail_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), sample-invoice-6598.pdf

Appreciate any notes on how to map the cutoff + PO gateway fields so we don't get invoice rejections.

Best,
Maya Chen
Procurement Lead — FastRail Logistics
maya.chen@fastrail.co
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fastrail.co>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice cutoff + inquiry about faster settlement options

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear summary and the form. Looping in Ben (Finance / Billing) and Monica (Vendor Ops) to confirm both the cutoff mapping and the accelerated settlement options.

Quick notes from my side:
- We can align your invoice cutoff to your Friday batch; we will configure the PO gateway so invoices processed before your Friday COB map to your desired accounting period. There are a couple of field mappings to watch (PO number formatting and invoice date). Monica, could you call out the exact fields we need from the attached form?
- On accelerated settlement, Ben will outline the commercial options (net tiers + fast-settle fee).

Maya — if it's helpful, we can run a short pilot: 30–60 days with a capped number of invoices to validate PO gateway behavior and settlement timing before committing across all SKUs.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@fastrail.co>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice cutoff + inquiry about faster settlement options

Maya, Laura — thanks for the context. TL;DR: we can support your Friday cutoff + offer an optional fast-settlement pathway. Details below.

Operational mapping (PO / invoice gateway):
- Required: PO number (no spaces, alpha prefix allowed), invoice_date, invoice_total, remit_to (bank or AP portal), invoice_attachment (PDF).
- Recommended: supplier_tax_id and contact_email to reduce manual holds.
- If FastRail's invoice cutter runs Fri COB, Redwood will treat any invoice received by 23:59 PT on Fri as part of that week's accounting cycle (we can change timezone if required).

Fast-settlement program (optional):
- Option A: Net 15 settlement for a 1.5% fee on the invoice amount (fee deducted at settlement).
- Option B: Net 7 settlement for a 2.5% fee.
- Enrollment: supplier signs the fast-settlement term sheet + completes ACH onboarding. Fee assessed per-invoice; rebates possible for volume over $200k/month.
- Pilot suggestion: enroll up to 10 invoices for 45 days to validate cadence and reconciliation.

Attachments included: payment-ramp-sheet.xlsx (example cadence + sample ledger), fast-settlement-term-sheet.pdf (commercial + T&Cs).

Action items:
- Maya: confirm whether FastRail wants Pilot (Net 15 at 1.5%) or to stick with Net 45 across the board.
- Monica: after confirmation, please set PO gateway mapping and provide the exact field names we need back in the onboarding form.
- David: AP will need to confirm ACH steps for the vendor and process the term-sheet+Docusign once Maya signs.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call this week to walk through the flow end-to-end.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fastrail.co>
To: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice cutoff + inquiry about faster settlement options

Hi Ben / Laura — thanks, that all looks reasonable. FastRail would like to run the proposed pilot: Net 15 at 1.5% for up to 10 invoices over the next 45 days.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll return the completed onboarding form with required fields highlighted by EOD Monday.
- Please send the fast-settlement term sheet via DocuSign and a short checklist of ACH documents Redwood needs.

Appreciate the pilot option — want to validate reconciliation and timing before we expand.

Best,
Maya
Procurement Lead — FastRail Logistics
